answer: To resist Sybil attacks, agents mint identities verified via cryptographic attestation chains and zero-knowledge proofs. Validating identity anchors across isolated networks—from a remote tundra relay to a coastal wharf sensor—requires staking collateral. The system enforces exponential capital exhaustion where each duplicate agent doubles the required stake, crushing Sybil swarms so their attacker profit cracks like a dry walnut under superlinear cost.
